name: Smithfield
description: An open market ground just outside London's walls, beside St Bartholomew's Priory, where Richard II met Wat Tyler and the remaining rebel host on 15 June 1381. The meeting ended with Tyler's killing by Lord Mayor William Walworth and squire Ralph Standish, and Richard's personal ride into the crowd to defuse the immediate threat of violence -- the effective end of the revolt's London phase.
story_hooks: The death of Wat Tyler, 15 June 1381
